concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-risk-management-chargeback-guidelines-cash-app-pay-chargebacks]] — Adyen Cash App Pay dispute guide (webpage snapshot, 2026-09-15) for initiation timing, NoC-based defense, liable-account debit, and final accepted-defense reversal.
warnings: Cash App Pay is distinct from Cash App Afterpay; this page does not state Afterpay's stage, fee, or decision terms.
The 13-day defense window begins at NoC. Funds return only if the merchant responds within 13 days and wins; a timely response alone does not reverse the debit.
